User is planning a Discord bot project that listens to JIRA webhooks and determines which Discord user to mention based on the event type.

dimension.purpose: to determine who to mention in a Discord server based on JIRA webhook events

memories.content: User designed a data model for a Discord bot project with entities User, EventRule, and UserType, with many-to-many relationships between User and EventRule, and between UserType and EventRule, and a one-to-many relationship from UserType to User.

User is associated with GMBM LTD, a company that has patented technology for sea rafts made from inside-concreted bottoms of shipping containers, capable of movement on water and land, connectable into arrays with power lift adaptability and hydraulic freight and passenger elevators, aimed at reducing seaport congestion and providing alternative real estate.

dimension.purpose: to reduce seaport congestion and provide an alternative to traditional real estate development
